title: Frontend Developer
description: Master modern frontend web development: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, React, Next.js, Web Performance, and Testing.

nodes.title: HTML & Modern CSS
nodes.description: Semantic HTML5, CSS Grid, Flexbox, responsive typography, CSS variables, and modern styling architectures.

children.title: Semantic HTML5 & Accessibility (a11y)
children.description: Semantic landmarks (<header>, <main>, <nav>), ARIA attributes, keyboard accessibility.

children.title: CSS Flexbox & CSS Grid
children.description: 1D flex layout vs 2D grid layout, subgrid, auto-fit/auto-fill responsiveness.

children.title: Responsive Design & Media Queries
children.description: Mobile-first CSS, fluid typography (clamp), container queries, viewport units.

nodes.title: JavaScript Mastery (ES6+)
nodes.description: DOM manipulation, asynchronous JS (Promises, async/await), closures, event loop, and prototype inheritance.

children.title: DOM Manipulation & Events
children.description: Event delegation, bubbling, capturing, DOM query selection, mutation observers.

children.title: Async JS, Promises & Fetch API
children.description: Event loop microtasks/macrotasks, Promise chaining, async/await error handling.

children.title: Closures, Scope & Prototypes
children.description: Lexical scope, closure memory leaks, prototype chain inheritance, 'this' keyword binding.

nodes.title: React.js Core & Hooks
nodes.description: Component lifecycle, JSX, virtual DOM reconciliation, state management, and custom hooks.

children.title: Components, Props & State
children.description: Functional components, props validation, useState immutability, synthetic events.

children.title: Effects & Custom Hooks
children.description: useEffect cleanup functions, dependency arrays, memoization (useMemo, useCallback), custom hooks.

children.title: Context API & Global State
children.description: Prop drilling elimination, Context API providers, Zustand/Redux Toolkit state management.

nodes.title: Next.js & Fullstack SSR
nodes.description: App Router, Server Components, Server Actions, Static Site Generation (SSG), Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR).

children.title: App Router & Server Components
children.description: React Server Components (RSC) vs Client Components ('use client'), layout hierarchies.

children.title: SSR, SSG, ISR & Server Actions
children.description: Dynamic server rendering, static export, revalidation triggers, form Server Actions.
